response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.average_quantity, o.average_quantity - b.average_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.average_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.average_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10;
